- [LLEX.12.2.1] **Unicode confusable normalisation.** The lexer normalises
  known look-alikes before symbol lookup:
  - μ (U+03BC GREEK SMALL LETTER MU) → µ (U+00B5 MICRO SIGN)
  - Ω (U+2126 OHM SIGN) → Ω (U+03A9 GREEK CAPITAL LETTER OMEGA)
  - ʹ (U+02B9 MODIFIER LETTER PRIME) → ′ (U+2032 PRIME); ʺ (U+02BA
    MODIFIER LETTER DOUBLE PRIME) → ″ (U+2033 DOUBLE PRIME)
  All input forms resolve to the same unit/glyph.
